title: No way to see a session's token use and the code's growth against its starting point
symptom: Token use can be read only through a development script, and nothing records how a file changed from the session start beyond a hash: the SessionStart baseline stores one sha256 string per file, so lines, bytes and whether a change was only alignment padding cannot be reported. There is no per-host page and no /boxbox -monitor entry.

rootCause.summary: The baseline was designed only for change detection, and session-record reading lives in a development tool. Adding sizes and a whitespace-insensitive hash to the baseline and moving the reader into the engine should allow a read-only report; the proposal lists what is measured and what remains an estimate.

requestedOutcome: /boxbox -monitor makes the agent run boxbox monitor, which writes one self-contained page per host under the plugin data folder showing token use by step, hook text, per-file lines and bytes before and after, whitespace-only versus content change, and hook results, without model calls and without copying message text.
decisions: 2026-10-22 user direction: build a /boxbox -monitor feature with a page per plugin showing token use and the increase in lines and bytes compared with before.

2026-10-22 user instruction to proceed with the recommended direction: record real inspector usage first and design the monitor meanwhile. Adopted defaults in the proposal: a product command, one page per host, current-project scope, no dollar cost.

actions.description: Write the design proposal with data sources, baseline v2, host differences, boundaries and acceptance criteria.
Token reader for Claude session records exists as development/tools/session-usage.ts; move it into the engine when the command is built.
Baseline v2 in the lifecycle hook (bytes, lines, whitespace-insensitive hash for supported files) readable alongside the old shape, with its size measured.
boxbox monitor --json, then the HTML renderer, the -monitor skill argument and docs.
Codex reader after a sanitized real rollout fixture exists.

verification.name: Monitor reports volume without leaking content or changing hook behavior

related.note: Existing Claude session reader that the monitor builds on.
Owns the SessionStart baseline and the hook receipts.
The model assignment evaluation needs the per-step data this report provides.

history.summary: User asked for a /boxbox -monitor page per plugin that shows token use and, against the earlier state, the increase in lines and bytes.

The baseline holds only hashes, so the footprint needs a new baseline shape; session-record token reading already works on real Claude sessions (usage counted once per message id); a Codex rollout carries token_count events but has no reader yet.
